Modules are version‑controlled separately (Git‑L10N) and can be swapped without touching the engine. | | **Hybrid Go‑to‑Market (GTM) Model** | Simultaneously sell to ministries/school districts **and** to parents/teachers via subscription or freemium. | Create a **B2G Sales Hub** (regional inside‑sales + local procurement consultants) & a **B2C Growth Hub** (digital acquisition, local ambassadors). | | **Data‑Sovereignty & Privacy‑First** | Each country has its own data‑privacy law (Vietnam’s PDPA, Saudi’s Cloud‑Localisation, France’s CNIL/GDPR, Kenya’s Data Protection Act). | Deploy **regional data clusters** (AWS Asia‑Pacific (Singapore) for Vietnam, AWS Middle‑East (Bahrain) for KSA, EU (Paris) for France, Africa (Cape Town) for Kenya). Use **privacy‑by‑design** APIs that auto‑mask any cross‑border flow. | | **Community‑Centric Trust Building** | Parents/teachers are gatekeepers of screen‑time and foreign content. | Provide **Parent‑Control Dashboard**, **Teacher‑Professional‑Development (PD) portal**, and **Local‑Content Advisory Boards**. | --- ### 2️⃣ COUNTRY‑LEVEL INSIGHTS & IMPACT MATRIX | Country | Mandatory Curriculum | Language‑of‑Instruction Rules | Parental Attitudes (Screen‑time / Foreign Content) | Procurement Landscape | Key Cultural / Legal Sensitivities | |---------|----------------------|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------------------| | **Vietnam** | Ministry of Education & Training (MOET) K‑12 core standards (2024). Alignment required to **Vietnamese national learning outcomes**. | Vietnamese is the sole language of instruction in public schools; English is allowed only for “foreign language” subjects. | • High concern about **excessive screen time** (esp. < 10 y).

• Rapid growth of **private tutoring** market (B2C). | • Must respect **political neutrality** (no references to contested territories).
• Content must be **culturally appropriate** (no depictions of gambling, alcohol). | | **Saudi Arabia** | Saudi Ministry of Education (MoE) – **Madar** (K‑12) and **Misk** (STEM) curricula; Arabic‑only for core subjects. | Arabic mandatory for all core subjects; English only for “foreign language”. Gender‑segregated classrooms (public). | • Parents demand **tight screen‑time limits** & **Islam‑compliant** material.
• Skeptical of “Western” pedagogies; openness to **Saudi‑crafted** STEM content. | • 80 % of public‑school spend is **government‑tendered** (MoE).
• Growing **private‑school** market (B2C). | • **Religious compliance** (no images of humans in certain contexts, no music).
• Data must reside **within Saudi‑approved cloud** (or have Saudi‑Sovereign‑Cloud certification). | | **France** | French Ministry of National Education – **Référentiel** (primary) & **Programme** (secondary). Strong emphasis on *“seamless integration into national pedagogy.”* | French is the sole medium; **regional languages** (Breton, Alsatian) allowed only as electives. | • High concern about **screen‑fatigue** and **privacy**.

• Private‑school & parent‑paid “Cahier d’activités” market (B2C). | • GDPR (CNIL) compliance mandatory; **child‑data consent** required.
• French cultural values (equality, secularism) influence content tone. | | **Kenya** | Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) – **8‑2‑4** system; emphasis on **competency‑based** outcomes. | English & Swahili both official mediums; **bilingual** instruction in most public schools. | • Parents value **affordability** and **real‑world skill outcomes** (e.g., coding).
